scenarios.question: What is GST and how does it apply to my business?
scenarios.template: GST concerns supplies of goods/services. Determine registration, supply classification and the transaction period before assessing obligations.

scenarios.question: What is the difference between CGST SGST UTGST and IGST?
scenarios.template: These are different GST tax heads. Ordinary domestic treatment depends on supplier location and legally determined place of supply; special rules can change the outcome.

scenarios.question: What is the difference between inward and outward supplies?
scenarios.template: Inward supplies are received by the business; outward supplies are made by it. The same invoice may be outward for the supplier and inward for the recipient.

scenarios.question: What is taxable value?
scenarios.template: Taxable value is the base used for tax calculation after applicable valuation adjustments. It is different from a tax-inclusive invoice total.

scenarios.question: What is the difference between input tax and output tax?
scenarios.template: Input tax relates to inward supplies; output tax relates to outward supplies. Recording input tax does not alone establish eligible credit.

scenarios.question: What is input tax credit?
scenarios.template: ITC is eligible input tax available under applicable conditions and restrictions. It is different from the full purchase invoice value. Ask for usable ITC to inspect your application figure.

scenarios.question: How do taxable nil rated exempt zero rated and non GST supplies differ?
scenarios.template: These classifications have different tax and credit consequences. Provide the supply description, transaction date and relevant evidence before choosing a classification; zero-rated does not mean every exempt supply.

scenarios.question: What are HSN and SAC codes?
scenarios.template: HSN classifies goods and SAC classifies services. A description or code alone is insufficient to guarantee a statutory rate; date, conditions and notifications matter.

scenarios.question: What is the difference between a tax invoice and a bill of supply?
scenarios.template: The appropriate document depends on the supplier and supply treatment. Do not use a bill of supply as proof that GST was charged and is creditable.

scenarios.question: How are invoice confirmation ITC eligibility and return filing different?
scenarios.template: Confirmation records an application review decision. ITC needs separate eligibility/reconciliation checks. Filing requires an authorized government process and acknowledgement.

scenarios.question: Does my business need GST registration?
scenarios.template: Provide state, activities, turnover period, supply types and any compulsory-registration facts. Registration cannot be decided from turnover alone without the applicable rules.

scenarios.question: Which GST registration category applies to my business?
scenarios.template: Share the business activity and whether it involves composition, ISD, TDS/TCS, SEZ, non-resident, OIDAR or UIN treatment. Eligibility needs period-specific review.

scenarios.question: What information is saved in my GST business profile?
scenarios.template: Open the account menu, Business Profile and inspect the selected business identity, registration, address, contacts, website and preferences. Missing optional fields are not fabricated.

scenarios.question: Is my saved GSTIN structurally valid?
scenarios.template: Use the GST registration/checks panel in Business Profile. Format/checksum checks are different from a live registration or ownership verification.

scenarios.question: Has my GST registration been verified against an authorized provider?
scenarios.template: Inspect Business Profile verification source, time and outcome. If automatic verification is unconfigured, no provider verification can be claimed; opening the portal is not verification.

scenarios.question: Do I need separate registration for operations in another state?
scenarios.template: Provide states, establishments and activities. Additional-state registration is a legal applicability question, not an automatic consequence of any interstate sale.

scenarios.question: Can one business have multiple GST registrations?
scenarios.template: Separate registrations can require separate books/obligations. The current selected-business context must be preserved; do not merge records solely because a PAN or name matches.

scenarios.question: How do regular and composition taxpayers differ?
scenarios.template: Their eligibility, documents, credit and returns differ. Verify current scheme eligibility before changing a profile; do not apply regular-taxpayer ITC assumptions to composition.

scenarios.question: What happens when registration is cancelled?
scenarios.template: Check the effective date, pending obligations, final-return applicability and cancellation order. Cancellation does not establish that all past compliance is complete.

scenarios.question: How do I update business details safely?
scenarios.template: Select the intended business, open Business Profile, edit permitted fields and save. Check success and refresh. GSTIN edits may require separate permission.

scenarios.question: Is the GST arithmetic on this invoice correct?
scenarios.template: Open the identified invoice, compare the original and run the review validation. Supply the invoice reference; a statement of arithmetic accuracy is not legal rate approval.

scenarios.question: Does the invoice total match taxable value tax and adjustments?
scenarios.template: Use invoice review to compare line totals, tax heads, charges and documented round-off against the original. Identify the invoice; do not insert an unexplained adjustment to force a match.

scenarios.question: How do I calculate GST when the price excludes tax?
scenarios.template: For a simple single-rate example, tax equals taxable value multiplied by the applicable rate divided by 100. Supply values and the approved rate; do not assume 18% for every supply.

scenarios.question: How do I extract GST from a tax inclusive amount?
scenarios.template: For a simple single-rate inclusive price, base equals total divided by (1 + rate/100); tax is the difference. Mixed rates, cess and extra charges require separate treatment.

scenarios.question: How should a discount affect taxable value?
scenarios.template: Provide when the discount was agreed, invoice treatment, linkage and any credit-note facts. Not every post-sale discount automatically reduces GST value.

scenarios.question: How should freight insurance and handling charges be treated?
scenarios.template: Provide who charges them, contractual terms, invoice presentation and supply classification. Charges cannot be classified for GST solely by their label.

scenarios.question: How do I check an invoice containing multiple tax rates?
scenarios.template: Review each line with its own taxable value, approved rate and tax heads, then aggregate. Do not apply an average rate to the invoice total.

scenarios.question: Should this invoice use IGST or CGST with SGST UTGST?
scenarios.template: Provide supplier location, legally determined place of supply, supply type and special facts such as SEZ/export treatment. Customer postal address alone is not always decisive.

scenarios.question: Why does the system show a rounding or tax head mismatch?
scenarios.template: Open Validation Details and compare each line and total with the original. Resolve the specific code; do not silently rewrite source evidence.

scenarios.question: What evidence confirms the applicable rate on the invoice date?
scenarios.template: Provide description, HSN/SAC, invoice date and conditions/exemptions. A professional should verify the effective notification before material rate decisions.

scenarios.question: What are my confirmed sales for the selected period?
scenarios.template: Open the Sales Register for the selected period. The confirmed invoice-value metric includes tax and signed note effects; it is different from taxable sales.

scenarios.question: What are my taxable sales and output GST by tax head?
scenarios.template: Use the sales/tax-head report with the same period. Taxable value and invoice value must be labelled separately; unavailable subtotals must not be guessed.

scenarios.question: Which sales invoices are pending review or rejected?
scenarios.template: Open Bills and Vouchers and filter status and sales direction. Rejected and pending records must not be included as confirmed sales.

scenarios.question: What are my recorded B2B and B2C sales?
scenarios.template: This needs supported customer-registration classification and a dedicated register breakdown. Do not infer registered status from a customer name.

scenarios.question: What are my intrastate and interstate sales?
scenarios.template: Use classified sales evidence with place-of-supply validation. If the breakdown is unavailable, review the Sales Register rather than inferring it from addresses.

scenarios.question: Which customers account for the highest confirmed sales?
scenarios.template: This requires an exhaustive grouped sales query. The assistant's small evidence sample cannot establish a complete ranking; use a supported report.

scenarios.question: How have sales credit notes affected my totals?
scenarios.template: Inspect confirmed credit notes and their period/sign in the Sales Register. Do not count a credit note as an additional positive sale.

scenarios.question: How should a debit note affect sales records?
scenarios.template: Link the original transaction and check reason, date, taxable value and tax increase. Review the note through normal confirmation and period controls.

scenarios.question: How should advances and later invoice adjustments be treated?
scenarios.template: Provide goods/services classification, dates and existing advance/invoice records. Do not treat every receipt as a fresh taxable sale.

scenarios.question: Why do my sales register and return working paper differ?
scenarios.template: Compare scope, status, notes, adjustments and source versions. Reprepare a stale paper only after investigating the difference.

scenarios.question: What are my confirmed purchases for the selected period?
scenarios.template: Open Purchase Register. Confirmed invoice value includes tax and signed notes; unconfirmed records are excluded.

scenarios.question: How much ITC is currently usable?
scenarios.template: Ask for usable ITC in the selected period. It is an application-calculated amount subject to source coverage and statutory eligibility, not a guarantee of a portal claim.

scenarios.question: What is my usable ITC split by tax head?
scenarios.template: Use the current tax-head summary. IGST, CGST, SGST/UTGST and cess must remain separate.

scenarios.question: Which purchases have no usable ITC?
scenarios.template: Open Purchases Without ITC and inspect each reason and source. Absence of usable credit is not always permanent ineligibility.

scenarios.question: Which credits are blocked deferred or pending evidence?
scenarios.template: Use credit decisions and their rule references. Reconciliation delays, blocked categories and missing evidence are separate reasons.

scenarios.question: Can I claim ITC on capital goods?
scenarios.template: Provide business use, asset details, depreciation/tax treatment, supply mix and documents. Capital goods do not create an unconditional credit entitlement.

scenarios.question: How should personal exempt and business use be separated?
scenarios.template: Identify the actual use and relevant period. Mixed use may require apportionment/reversal calculations and supporting evidence.

scenarios.question: What happens if supplier payment conditions are not met?
scenarios.template: Provide invoice, receipt/payment dates and credit already availed. Any reversal/reclaim requires the applicable period-specific conditions, not a guessed deadline.

scenarios.question: Which ITC reversals or reclaims need review?
scenarios.template: Inspect reversal/reclaim evidence and reasons. If the records are not captured, the assistant cannot claim a complete list.

scenarios.question: What time limits affect this ITC claim?
scenarios.template: Provide invoice/debit-note date, financial year, return history and special facts. Verify effective statutory limits and exceptions professionally before claiming.

scenarios.question: Has GSTR 2B been imported for this period?
scenarios.template: Check Returns and Credit statement status for the selected GSTIN and period. A missing statement prevents statement-based matching conclusions.

scenarios.question: Which purchases match the imported statement?
scenarios.template: Use Reconciliation Cases with the matched filter and inspect evidence. A match is not complete ITC eligibility approval.

scenarios.question: Which purchases are in books but not GSTR 2B?
scenarios.template: Use books-only cases after a statement is imported. Check supplier reporting, period and invoice identity before deciding credit treatment.

scenarios.question: Which statement records are missing from books?
scenarios.template: Use statement-only cases. Request the missing original or investigate incorrect association; do not invent a purchase record.

scenarios.question: Which invoices have amount or tax head mismatches?
scenarios.template: Use mismatch cases and compare the original, statement and book values. Keep amount and tax-head differences distinct.

scenarios.question: Could punctuation explain an invoice number mismatch?
scenarios.template: Punctuation can suggest a candidate, but validate GSTIN, date, amounts and duplicate identity before treating it as matched.

scenarios.question: Are there duplicate reconciliation candidates?
scenarios.template: Inspect duplicate candidates and source versions. Do not count multiple rows for the same logical invoice as independent credit.

scenarios.question: Why does a credit note differ between books and statement?
scenarios.template: Compare note identity, original linkage, date, signed amounts and the relevant statement generation version.

scenarios.question: What do IMS accept reject pending and no action mean?
scenarios.template: IMS treatment depends on document type and applicable period. Internal review is not a submitted government IMS decision; use the current official IMS guidance.

scenarios.question: Does a GSTR 2B match automatically approve ITC?
scenarios.template: No. Matching is evidence; eligibility, restrictions, documents and other statutory conditions remain separate checks.

scenarios.question: Could this transaction attract reverse charge?
scenarios.template: Provide supply description, supplier/recipient category, date and notification facts. Do not infer RCM solely from an unregistered supplier.

scenarios.question: What is my recorded reverse charge liability?
scenarios.template: Use supported RCM records and the working paper. If those records are not captured, an ordinary sales total is not a substitute.

scenarios.question: When can reverse charge tax become eligible ITC?
scenarios.template: Check actual payment, receipt, documents, business use and restrictions under applicable rules. Liability recognition alone is insufficient.

scenarios.question: What facts determine transport or GTA treatment?
scenarios.template: Identify the provider, consignment-note facts, recipient category, service date, chosen treatment and applicable conditions. The word freight alone cannot determine the rate.

scenarios.question: How should imported goods be recorded?
scenarios.template: Keep bill-of-entry and import tax evidence alongside the purchase. Do not substitute supplier invoice tax for actual import IGST evidence.

scenarios.question: How should an import of services be assessed?
scenarios.template: Provide supplier/recipient location, service description, place-of-supply facts and consideration. Cross-border treatment requires case-specific review.

scenarios.question: How do exports with and without payment of IGST differ?
scenarios.template: Confirm export eligibility, relevant period, LUT/bond and payment/refund conditions. Do not classify a foreign customer alone as a qualifying export.

scenarios.question: What evidence supports supplies to an SEZ?
scenarios.template: Check recipient status, authorized-operation evidence, supply documents and applicable treatment. SEZ tax handling needs separate review.

scenarios.question: How should branch transfers or job work be reviewed?
scenarios.template: Identify ownership/registrations, movement, documents and return timeline. Not every stock movement is the same taxable event.

scenarios.question: What GST facts matter for e commerce settlements?
scenarios.template: Separate sales, returns, commission, operator liabilities, TCS and payments. A net settlement is not automatically taxable turnover.

scenarios.question: Which GST returns apply to my taxpayer category?
scenarios.template: Confirm registration type, period and frequency. Regular, composition, ISD, TDS/TCS, non-resident, OIDAR and UIN obligations differ; ask for the specific form guide.

scenarios.question: What outward supply information belongs in GSTR 1?
scenarios.template: Classify sales, notes and amendments using the applicable form tables. Ask how to file GSTR-1 for the portal sequence.

scenarios.question: What is GSTR 1A and when is it relevant?
scenarios.template: It is a same-period correction/addition facility subject to its permitted window and prerequisites. Ask for the GSTR-1A guide; do not assume GSTR-3B is freely revisable.

scenarios.question: What figures support GSTR 3B preparation?
scenarios.template: Reconcile sales liability, RCM, eligible credit, reversals and payment facts. Ask how to file GSTR-3B for guided portal stages.

scenarios.question: Do my GSTR 1 and GSTR 3B figures reconcile?
scenarios.template: This needs actual return versions, scope and adjustments. Application working papers alone do not prove what was filed on the portal.

scenarios.question: What should I check before a nil return?
scenarios.template: Check all relevant supply, liability, credit and adjustment facts against the form's eligibility conditions. Zero recorded sales alone does not prove nil eligibility.

scenarios.question: How do QRMP and IFF affect reporting?
scenarios.template: Check opted frequency, relevant month and records already furnished. Do not report IFF invoices a second time in the quarterly reconciliation.

scenarios.question: What is needed for CMP 08 and GSTR 4?
scenarios.template: Verify composition applicability, quarter/year, payment statements, books and RCM facts. Ask for either form's portal guide.

scenarios.question: What supports annual GSTR 9 and GSTR 9C reconciliation?
scenarios.template: Gather books, filed returns, notes, tax/credit adjustments and payment evidence. Check year-specific applicability before preparation.

scenarios.question: What is preventing my working paper review?
scenarios.template: Open the current preparation exceptions and source versions. Resolve validation, stale inputs and permissions before submission.

scenarios.question: What is my estimated GST cash requirement?
scenarios.template: Use the selected-period application calculation. It is not proof of payment or a full opening/carry-forward portal ledger position.

scenarios.question: How much liability is covered by usable credit?
scenarios.template: Use the supported tax-head utilization summary with the same period. Do not subtract a total credit pool indiscriminately from all liabilities.

scenarios.question: How do cash credit and liability ledgers differ?
scenarios.template: Cash ledger records deposits/use, credit ledger records eligible credit/use and liability register records obligations. Obtain authoritative ledger evidence for actual balances.

scenarios.question: What opening balances are needed for payment assessment?
scenarios.template: Gather tax-head opening balances, liabilities, utilization and adjustments. Quarter/year application estimates do not supply a complete carry-forward ledger.

scenarios.question: How may credits be utilized?
scenarios.template: Credit utilization is tax-head and effective-rule dependent. Use approved backend calculations and current ledger facts; do not invent cross-head set-off.

scenarios.question: Why does estimated cash differ from the portal?
scenarios.template: Compare opening balances, actual liability, eligible credit, RCM, interest/fees, payments and period. The application estimate is not the official ledger.

scenarios.question: What are PMT 06 and a challan?
scenarios.template: They support depositing amounts into the cash ledger. Deposit is distinct from offsetting liability and filing; ask how to create a challan for guidance.

scenarios.question: What proves payment was credited?
scenarios.template: Check bank/payment reference, portal challan/CIN status and ledger credit. A bank debit or generated challan alone is not filing proof.

scenarios.question: Could interest apply to my delay?
scenarios.template: Provide liability, credit/payment, due-date and actual discharge facts. Use the applicable rules and notified relief; no flat guess is appropriate.

scenarios.question: Could late fees extensions or waivers apply?
scenarios.template: Provide form, taxpayer type, state and period. Verify the applicable notification rather than using a permanent hardcoded deadline.

scenarios.question: Which refund category fits my case?
scenarios.template: Describe the transaction, tax/payment facts and refund reason. Eligibility, limitation and documents depend on category; ask for RFD-01 navigation.

scenarios.question: What evidence supports export or SEZ refunds?
scenarios.template: Collect relevant supply, export/SEZ, tax/credit and realization evidence as applicable. Required documents vary by category and period.

scenarios.question: What is needed for an inverted duty refund?
scenarios.template: Provide supply/rate classifications, inputs, output and credit records. Do not infer eligibility solely because purchase tax exceeds sales tax.

scenarios.question: How can excess cash ledger balance be reviewed for refund?
scenarios.template: Obtain the actual cash ledger and relevant liability/payment evidence before preparing the applicable refund request.

scenarios.question: What is my refund application status?
scenarios.template: Use the official ARN/status or authorized imported evidence. GST Easy cannot claim a live portal status without that evidence.

scenarios.question: What does this notice require and what deadline is shown?
scenarios.template: Supply a redacted notice and its dates/reference. Identify the requested documents and obtain professional review; do not invent an extension or reply.

scenarios.question: What records support a discrepancy reply?
scenarios.template: Gather the notice, period-specific books, filed returns, reconciliation, payment and original evidence. Explain differences with traceable versions.

scenarios.question: What should an ISD check for GSTR 6?
scenarios.template: Review received credit, eligible distribution, recipients and amendments under current rules. Use the GSTR-6 portal guide for navigation.

scenarios.question: What obligations apply to TDS TCS non resident OIDAR or UIN taxpayers?
scenarios.template: Specify your registration category and form: GSTR-7, GSTR-8, GSTR-5, GSTR-5A or GSTR-11. Each has separate eligibility and preparation requirements.

scenarios.question: What needs review for cancellation revocation or final return?
scenarios.template: Identify the order/application, effective date and pending obligations. Ask for cancellation, revocation or GSTR-10 guidance separately.

scenarios.question: How do I upload purchase and sales bills?
scenarios.template: Choose the correct business/period, open Bills and Vouchers, Upload Bills, select supported files and submit once. Review direction, evidence and extracted values before confirmation.

scenarios.question: Which invoice formats are supported?
scenarios.template: The invoice uploader supports PDF, JPEG/JPG, PNG, XLSX and CSV within displayed limits. Use the expected spreadsheet template; do not assume arbitrary ZIP or workbook compatibility.

scenarios.question: Why is my bill still processing?
scenarios.template: Inspect Upload History and the per-file result. Use Retry saved upload only when offered; repeated new uploads risk duplicates.

scenarios.question: How do I correct extracted values and retain the original?
scenarios.template: Open Review, inspect View Original Bill, edit evidence-supported fields, Save Changes and read validation. Source evidence and history must remain retained.

scenarios.question: How do I reject request correction and resubmit?
scenarios.template: Reject with a category/reason. Use Bill corrections, request correction, edit/save and resubmit through available controls. Resubmission is not confirmation.

scenarios.question: What changes when Auto Review is ON or OFF?
scenarios.template: OFF retains validation but requires manual confirmation. ON evaluates eligible bills; all hard gates still apply and missing legal policy can keep a bill manual.

scenarios.question: How do I run Auto Review on existing pending bills?
scenarios.template: In Invoice Intelligence enable the existing or both scope, inspect the eligible count and Run Auto Review. Up to 100 records are handled per durable batch.

scenarios.question: Why is this invoice in Requires Attention?
scenarios.template: Open Review and Validation Details for the specific reasons. Fix evidence-supported errors; do not force a total or bypass a policy gate.

scenarios.question: Why was this invoice flagged as duplicate?
scenarios.template: Compare original file identity, supplier, invoice number, date/financial year and existing record. A renamed copy is not a different invoice.

scenarios.question: Why can I not confirm edit or approve this record?
scenarios.template: Check membership, required permission, record status, latest version and period locks. Do not borrow another user's credentials.

scenarios.question: Why did usable ITC change since the previous period?
scenarios.template: This needs two period-scoped snapshots, notes, eligibility and reconciliation decisions. The current-period evidence sample cannot prove a complete comparison.

scenarios.question: Why did cash requirement rise even though sales fell?
scenarios.template: Compare liability, usable credit, RCM, notes and adjustments across both periods. Do not infer the cause from sales alone.

scenarios.question: Which suppliers have the largest unresolved differences?
scenarios.template: Use an exhaustive grouped reconciliation report. A few retrieved invoices cannot establish a ranking for the whole business.

scenarios.question: Which invoices have multiple issues and need review first?
scenarios.template: Use Requires Attention filters and full validation reasons. Prioritize material identity, evidence and arithmetic failures with the authorized reviewer.

scenarios.question: Is a GSTIN mismatch a problem when the total is correct?
scenarios.template: Yes. Correct arithmetic cannot override a wrong business identity. Investigate the original and selected context before confirmation.

scenarios.question: How does a credit note in another period affect review?
scenarios.template: Check the original linkage, note date, financial year, applicable adjustment rules and filed/locked periods. Do not silently backdate it.

scenarios.question: Is an invoice repeated in Vendor Customer and Driver feeds?
scenarios.template: Cross-reference stable source IDs, invoice identity and booking/trip links. Payments or settlements must not create duplicate taxable invoices.

scenarios.question: Why do dashboard export and approved snapshot differ?
scenarios.template: Compare selected period, refresh time, status, source versions and adjustments. Exports can be current while a snapshot preserves an earlier approved version.

scenarios.question: What changes after a filing period is locked?
scenarios.template: Mutations are restricted. Use permitted reopening/correction procedures and record a reason; do not alter a confirmed financial record through chat.

scenarios.question: What evidence is missing before completing this period?
scenarios.template: Review pending invoices, statements, reconciliation exceptions, eligibility evidence and approval prerequisites. Missing portal ledgers/acknowledgements cannot be inferred from application data.
